market_regime: 混合Risk-off/政策信用；原油战争溢价回吐但精炼品物理短缺持续；黄金政策信用属性仍强；AI资本成本去风险；中国IH>IF>IM防御轮动
one_sentence_conclusion: 混合Risk-off/政策信用：制裁升级前原油反跌、黄金仍强；中国确认IH>IF>IM，但当日期权/OI缺口使其未进全球前三。
changes_vs_previous: Oil fell ahead of tougher Iran sanctions while Asian refined-product imports remain 21% below pre-war levels and Singapore gasoil margin was about $71.29/bbl on Aug-21; refined-product convexity is cleaner than crude beta.

China style signal changed from IF-over-IM to a clearer IH>IF>IM defensive hierarchy: IH outperformed IF by about 0.73ppt and IM by about 0.99ppt on futures; IF only beat IM by about 0.26ppt and failed the prior >=0.35ppt add threshold.
Gold policy-credit thesis remains structurally intact, but Monday's marginal move is less abnormal because long yields eased while gold rose and the dollar stayed weak.
AI financing-cost factor gained a fresh example as Alibaba announced a discounted roughly $10.2bn equity raise to fund AI investments; Nvidia earnings remain the key fundamental regime test.

PBOC liquidity was supportive with RMB340bn 7-day reverse repos and announced overnight operations from Aug-27, yet high-beta China equities underperformed, strengthening the risk-preference rather than funding-stress interpretation.
